summary: Takagi/Steinitz source-hunt and corpus-audit packets. These packages do not add promoted reader coverage. They correct local status: Steinitz 1914 Bedingt II is complete in the current working packets, 1916 Bedingt III is the active continuation through p.13 with p.14 next, and the formerly unresolved Steinitz 1908 Analysis Situs source gap is now partially closed by a 22-page 300-ppi Ranicki offprint witness. The later project_handoffs ZIPs add a compact docs/manifest handoff and a larger Takagi source-intake handoff with UTokyo/JSTAGE/NDL material. Takagi remains intake-only: local UTokyo witnesses cover 1903, 1920, and 1922, but are effectively about 400 ppi, while the existing Takagi aid PNGs are locator-only.

packages.status: Source-hunt/audit/handoff packet only. It includes CSV status ledgers, a corpus priority table, the Takagi/Steinitz corpus audit note, Steinitz Bedingt progress files, and the Steinitz 1908 Ranicki offprint PDF witness.

Takagi source-intake/project handoff: UTokyo 1903/1920/1922 PDFs, existing 1920 aid ZIP, JSTAGE/NDL source-hunt material, and status ledgers. Intake only; not source-checked TeX production.
